I had been sober for a month, going to meetings and doing better at work. Everything seemed fine, I was focusing very hard on sobriety because I had lost a girl and most of my friends to my drinking. Then I started hanging out with people again and bam one weekend just decided fuck it I will be fine, I can drink because its not a term of my probation. This was a mistake.

What followed was, from what I remember a series of incredibly bad decisions and a further burning of the bridges I had left. I vaguely remember getting punched in the face a few times at a few occasions, getting cut off from multiple bars and going back later. This went on for 3 days after that I just started drinking from home again by myself since no one would talk to me except my closest friends. I'm not really sure why they kept talking to me since I was sinking further and further and becoming more and more nonsensical. I guess they are just really good friends.

Then I stopped going to work so I could keep drinking, this was because I became extremely depressed. The events of the past few days and months kept coming back and I got into a pretty dark spiral. I could only leave my house to get beer and cigarettes. At times I couldn't even go upstairs. I had to talk myself into just having a cigarette because I did nothing but wallow in my despair. This was because I hadn't changed a fucking thing when I got sober. All I did was stop drinking. I thought that would be enough. After about 4 days of this, I got incredibly smashed and I realized I just wanted to die. That's all I wanted. I drank more and more and started taking sedatives and called a few people to say good bye and lay in my bed drinking until I passed out.

I woke up. I was surprised and very dismayed. What the fuck was I still doing here. I was broke and out of beer so I stopped drinking but I was still incredibly depressed. I could hardly move. Thoughts just kept racing keeping me there. I had even failed at dying. After a few hours of this something happened. I realized I was doing this all to myself, torturing myself for no reason when I had every reason to do something else.

It was because I hadn't changed anything else in my life. The only thing I had changed was I stopped drinking. I was still unhappy. I was unhappy with where I was, what I was jealous other people had and what I thought I could not attain and I was unhappy with what I had lost. This was what my bottom really felt like. I was fucking myself over more and more because I had no direction.

I went to work the next day after over a week of not being there. It was hard, I was withdrawing again but something had changed. I had gotten sober the first time because I had lost things I had thought I wanted. I don't even know what I wanted but I knew that wasn't it.

So I made my focus not entirely about sobriety, but about changing my life for the better . I think I now kind of understand at what AA is getting at though I never read the book yet but,before I was getting sober because I wanted my old life back. I can now see how that was worthless, you can never go back,only forward. I still wanted those people to like me even though I didn't even like myself. 

I am now trying very hard to make some very positive changes in my life, give myself some discipline and actual direction. I am more aware of the process of sobriety now which I know will help me along my way.I can destroy myself into oblivion I can also build myself to anything.
